scope: Six additional exact performed preparations read directly in cached primary patents. Named structures independently transcribed; no analogue blanket approval, no claim for auxiliary conditions or microscopic electron paths. Full population must be reaggregated separately.

records.locator: Example 2(a), intermediate 7: 4-amino-5-chloro-2,3-dihydro-7-benzofurancarbonyl chloride; before esterification in Example 2(b).
records.source_conditions: Acid 4.3 g, thionyl chloride 100 mL and chloroform 200 mL; reflux 2 h, cool and evaporate, then add and evaporate toluene. Source reports 4.8 g, 100% crude residue, carried into Example 2(b).
records.experimental_product_status: Explicitly named crude intermediate; not a purified isolated yield.
records.structural_reconciliation: Transcribed the 4-amino,5-chloro,7-carbonyl substitution pattern and the 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran ring from the preparation; only carboxylic OH changes to Cl. Ring chlorine and amino group are retained.

records.locator: Example 110(b), tert-butyl 3-[(methylsulfonyl)oxy]-1-azetanecarboxylate, before the subsequent nucleophilic substitution.
records.source_conditions: N-Boc-3-hydroxyazetidine 4.0 g/0.023 mol in anhydrous pyridine 50 mL; methanesulfonyl chloride 5.3 g/0.046 mol added at -20 C under nitrogen. Stir -20 to -30 C 1 h, then 0 to -5 C 2 h. Aqueous workup and extraction give 4.85 g/0.019 mol brownish oil; NMR reported.
records.experimental_product_status: Recovered brownish oil with mass, molar amount and NMR; no explicit percentage yield assigned.
records.structural_reconciliation: The patent's azetane spelling denotes the four-membered N-Boc azetidine ring shown in the precursor and product. O-mesylation at position 3 retains the Boc group and ring size, not N-mesylation or a cyclobutane analogue.

records.locator: Example 92(i), 2-chloro-N-(5-cyano-2-methylphenyl)acetamide, by the procedure of Example 33(iii); not the chiral piperazine coupling in 92(ii).
records.source_conditions: 5-Cyano-2-methylaniline 1.6 g and chloroacetyl chloride 1.1 mL; source explicitly invokes Example 33(iii), using DIPEA in dichloromethane at 0 C under nitrogen for 2 h before aqueous workup. Example 92(i) gives 1.85 g white solid; APCI negative m/z 207 (M-1).
records.experimental_product_status: White solid, isolated mass and MS reported; no percentage yield inferred.
records.structural_reconciliation: Independent name transcription gives aniline methyl at position 2 and cyano at 5 relative to acylated N. Chloroacetyl chloride supplies both carbonyl and retained CH2Cl. No stereochemistry or product from the following piperazine substitution is transferred.

records.locator: Reference Example 198, 4-isothiocyanato-3-methylbenzamide, distinct from its later use to prepare a thiourea.
records.source_conditions: Thiophosgene 2.57 mL/34.6 mmol added dropwise to 4-amino-3-methylbenzamide 2.60 g/17.3 mmol in THF 43 mL and saturated aqueous sodium bicarbonate 43 mL at 0 C. Stir at room temperature 10 min, extract, evaporate and wash with diisopropyl ether; 3.02 g/15.7 mmol, 91%, NMR and MS.
records.experimental_product_status: Recovered brown solid with percentage yield, NMR and MS.
records.structural_reconciliation: The aromatic amine is converted to N=C=S while the primary benzamide and the adjacent ring methyl are retained. Thiophosgene is S=CCl2, not phosgene or a later thiourea coupling substrate.

records.locator: Intermediate 71C, preparation of 3-cyano-N-methyl-5-nitrobenzenesulfonamide; before reduction of the nitro group.
records.source_conditions: Intermediate 71B sulfonyl chloride 150 mg/0.61 mmol in DCM 4 mL; methylamine 2 M in THF, 1.5 mL/3.0 mmol and triethylamine 0.424 mL/3.04 mmol. Room temperature 1 h, aqueous workup and silica chromatography; 45 mg, 31%, white solid, HPLC and NMR.
records.experimental_product_status: Chromatographically purified white solid with yield and NMR.
records.structural_reconciliation: Substitution of sulfonyl chloride by methylamine gives SO2NHMe. Cyano and nitro groups remain in the 1,3,5 ring pattern; nitro charge-separated representation is preserved, not reduced to aniline.

records.locator: Compound 11, 3-chloro-N-(pyridin-4-yl)benzamide, following the immediately preceding acid-chloride amidation procedure.
records.source_conditions: 4-Aminopyridine 0.18 g/1.9 mmol and 3-chlorobenzoyl chloride 0.51 g/2.9 mmol, following the preceding procedure: aqueous NaOH/DCM, acid chloride added over 30 min at room temperature and stir a further 2 h. Workup and silica chromatography (CHCl3/MeOH/Et3N 9.8:0.1:0.1) give white crystals, 52%; NMR reported.
records.experimental_product_status: Chromatographically isolated white crystals, percentage yield and NMR.
records.structural_reconciliation: 3-Chlorobenzoyl chloride acylates the exocyclic amino group of 4-aminopyridine. Ring chlorine remains meta to the carbonyl, and pyridine ring N is not the acylated atom. The acid chloride is the stated substrate, not the carboxylic acid used for other compounds in this patent.
